en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Whichever Believers is preserving upon the Obligatory Salāt, so he prays these upon their (Prescribed) timings, so this one is not from the oblivious (unaware) ones’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Darraj from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Whoever of the believers preserves his obligatory Salah (prayers) and performs them in time, he is not of the neglectful people.’”
